patch.value:
## The measurement that produced this

Recurrence census over all 2,007 terminal items, 2026-08-07, counting distinct terminal items that linked each source file:

| items | file |
|---|---|
| 247 | src/cli/main.ts |
| 147 | src/sdk/cli-contracts.ts |
| 110 | src/cli/commands/completion.ts |
| 105 | src/sdk/index.ts |
| 91 | src/cli/commands/create.ts |
| 76 | src/cli/commands/update.ts |
| 65 | src/mcp/server.ts |
| 49 | src/cli/commands/contracts.ts |

Twelve percent of every closed and canceled item in this tracker touched one file. The set is not a list of fragile modules. It is, almost exactly, the replication set the contributor guidance already enumerates as mandatory when a command is added or changed: the command barrel and entrypoint, the contract table with its names, actions, flag contracts and schema contracts, the MCP server registration, the mutation registrar, the contracts command, the three shell completions, the docs, and the test config.

## The defect class

A single logical change — one command, one flag, one action — must be written by hand at eight to twelve places that no artifact connects. When it is written at some and not all, the result is a command that parses but has no contract, a flag that the CLI accepts and the MCP tool does not declare, a completion that offers a spelling nothing implements, or a documented example that cannot run. Every one of those has occurred here repeatedly and each was filed and fixed as an individual defect.

The requirement is real and correct. Its enforcement is a checklist in a markdown file, which is enforcement by prose, and the ADR ruling on this is explicit: any decision that can stop the project reads declared contract artifacts, never human-readable text. A checklist cannot fail a build. It can only be followed, and the census is the measure of how often it was not.

## Why the existing gates do not catch it

Surface tiering makes visibility derive from one declared field, which removes one of the replicated sites but leaves the rest. The command-grammar conformance gate rejects a noun or verb outside the allowlist, which catches a *wrong* registration and not a *missing* one. The contracts drift check regenerates artifacts, so a change that never reached the contract table produces no drift to detect. Changeset traceability proves a change references an item, not that the change is complete. None of them reads the diff and asks whether the replication set was satisfied.

## What is being asked for

A replication set declared as contract data, not prose: for each kind of surface change — new command, new subcommand, new flag, new action, new item type, new error code — the ordered set of artifacts that must change together, each with the rule that decides whether it did.

A gate that reads the changeset. When a diff touches any member of a declared set, the check requires every other member to be satisfied, and reports the missing ones by name with the rule each failed. A partial change fails before merge rather than being discovered later as a defect.

An escape hatch that is recorded rather than silent. A deliberate partial change is expressible as a waiver naming the omitted member and the reason, and the waiver is a queryable event, matching how the traceability gate already handles its exception.

A negative control. A fixture change that omits one member must fail the gate, proving the gate can fail; a gate that has never failed is a hypothesis.

## Bounds

This is not a coverage rule and not a size rule. It says nothing about how large a file may be or how many tests it needs. It says only that a set of artifacts declared to change together must change together. The set itself is authored deliberately and is small; if the set is wrong, the fix is to correct the declaration, and the declaration being wrong is visible in a way the current checklist being wrong is not.

## Adjacent signal worth wiring, not worth a second item

The file with the highest recurrence in the corpus is also the one nearest its size gate, at 99 percent of the 3,400-line cap. Recurrence density and cap proximity are tracked by two unrelated items, neither reads the other, and their join identifies the highest-value decomposition target the record can produce on its own. The recurrence index should expose that join as an output rather than leave it to be recomputed by hand.
The mandatory command-wiring replication set is enforced only by a prose checklist, and the census shows partial application is the single largest recurring defect class in the record

One logical surface change must be hand-written at eight to twelve artifacts that no declaration connects. A recurrence census over all 2,007 terminal items finds 247 of them touched src/cli/main.ts alone and the top file set is exactly the documented replication list, so partially applied wiring is the largest measured defect family. No gate reads a diff and asks whether the set was satisfied.

Replication sets are declared as contract data, one per kind of surface change, each member carrying the rule that decides whether it was satisfied; A pre-merge check reads the changeset, and when any member of a set is touched it fails on unsatisfied members, naming each and the rule it failed; A deliberate partial change is expressible only as a recorded, queryable waiver naming the omitted member and the reason, never as silence; A negative-control fixture that omits one member fails the gate in CI, proving the gate can fail; The gate runs locally and in hosted CI from the same declaration, and divergence between the two sides fails rather than being discovered; The recurrence index publishes the join of per-file recurrence density and size-cap proximity, so the highest-value decomposition target is an output rather than a manual comparison
A change that must touch a declared set of artifacts cannot merge having touched only some of them
The largest measured recurring defect family becomes a pre-merge failure instead of a post-release discovery, and the checklist agents are asked to remember becomes a check the build performs
The recurrence census has just quantified the family for the first time, and the grammar freeze will lock a surface whose registration sites are still connected only by prose
A diff touching any member of a declared replication set is required to satisfy every other member, or to carry a recorded waiver naming the omission and its reason

The replication set exists only as a markdown checklist; contracts drift cannot see a change that never reached the contract table, and grammar conformance rejects wrong registrations but not missing ones
